Title: Verify User Creation via POST /api/users
Preconditions: 1. REST API endpoint https://reqres.in is reachable.
Steps:
1. Prepare JSON payload:
   {
     "name": "Name 1",
     "email": "Name1@example.com",
     "job": "Automation Test Engineer"
   }
2. Send HTTP POST request to https://reqres.in/api/users with header Content-Type: application/json
3. Verify HTTP response status code
4. Parse response JSON body and validate created user attributes:
   - name equals 'Name 1'
   - email equals 'Name1@example.com'
   - job equals 'Automation Test Engineer'
   - id is generated
   - createdAt timestamp is present
Expected Result:
1. Payload constructed properly.
2. POST request dispatched to server.
3. HTTP status code is 201 Created.
4. Response body confirms user creation:
   - responseJson.name == 'Name 1'
   - responseJson.email == 'Name1@example.com'
   - responseJson.job == 'Automation Test Engineer'
   - id and createdAt are returned.
